libraries.name: dataTables.rowsGroup
libraries.note: RowsGroup for DataTables, a plugin that was never published to npm. Version taken from the file header.
Despite the file name this is mustache.js itself, not a jQuery plugin. The file is mustache.js of the 3.0.1 release minus its trailing newline, so the code is that release unchanged.

libraries.name: jquery.blockUI
libraries.note: jQuery BlockUI. Version taken from the file header, which reads "v20141123", a date rather than a release, so there is no matching npm version to point a purl at. The header says "Dual licensed: MIT/GPL" without naming a GPL version, so no license is recorded.

libraries.name: jquery.cookies
libraries.note: Version taken from the file name. Never published to npm under this name. The header says "Licensed under the BSD, MIT, and GPL (your choice!)", so no license is recorded.

libraries.name: sorttable
libraries.note: Stuart Langridge's sorttable, "version 2, 7th April 2007" per the header. Unrelated to the npm package of the same name and never published there.

The 3.5.5 release declares no license field, its bundled LICENSE file is BSD-3-Clause. The file is d3.min.js of that release with a "/*v3.5.5*/" banner added and a trailing newline appended, so the code is that release unchanged.
The header says "a custom version of dagre-d3 on top of v0.4.3" from http://github.com/andrewor14/dagre-d3, so this is a fork and the purl only identifies the version it is based on.
Version taken from the file header. The npm release ships only the CommonJS sources under lib/, not the browser bundle vendored here, so there is no published file to compare it with.

Version taken from the file header, which the npm build carries as well. The npm release ships a jquery.dataTables.min.js of the same version, but minified with different settings (extra parentheses, assignments ordered differently), so the two are not byte-identical.
The file is byte-identical in 1.13.5 and 1.13.6, so the release it was taken from cannot be determined by hashing. The lowest one is recorded.
